## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk resilience while HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND creates a credit divergence that keeps the market neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit/financial stress mixed: HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND → watch spreads.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (Dollar proxy) (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND → flat and TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND signal modestly easier conditions but no clear risk-on impulse.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND; Tech holding up: XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary XLY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) shows short-term weakness; style: Growth/momentum bias given XLK strength and tech vs financials ratio rising.

**5. US vs Global?**
US resilient: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND; EM outperformance pockets: EEM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) in CORRECTION → regional divergence.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Risk-on tape for select spec: ARKK (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND; crypto/speculative pullback: IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals and industrials strong: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy rally broad and pronounced: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) in RECOVERY and remains vulnerable.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (8/11) with XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND; DIVERGENCE: credit mix (HYG vs LQD) and China FXI CORRECTION create a cross-market friction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Energy and selective Tech — XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND — reduce exposure to China and crypto assets such as FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION and IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral (TLT BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND, Cloud/Software SKYY (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +21.23%) ABOVE TREND, Semis/Software IGV (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +11.08%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: China FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION, Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION, Crypto IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND, Gold GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND, Silver SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY—watch downside risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.75 (credit friction), SPY/TLT ~9.46 (stocks vs bonds balance), XLK/XLF ~3.27 (growth vs financials pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
Energy (XLE 1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) and Tech (XLK 1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) showing strength and growth/momentum leadership.  
Key risk is cross-market divergence—credit signals mixed (HYG 1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37% ABOVE TREND vs LQD 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86% BELOW TREND) and China FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) in CORRECTION—monitor closely.
